ambient_events: The empty ceiling hook turns a slow half-circle in the draft.
description: Unit 4A, top floor, street-facing. Best light in the building up here; what little the smog lets through comes in clean and level through a window that actually opens. A proper bed, a desk someone bolted to the wall, and a hook in the ceiling that used to hold a fan and now holds nothing, turning slowly in the draft. Quiet. Expensive-feeling, for the Embassy.

window.description: One small window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window

name: Unit 4A
